props.heading: What we check before we list
props.body:
• Lalpurja in the seller's name, and no loan pledged against it
  • Road width on the ground, not only on the map
  • Whether the plot sits on the mapped fault or river buffer
  • Completion certificate, for any house built after 2072

If a property fails, we do not list it.

props.heading: How a purchase works
props.body:
We visit together, you choose, and we agree the price in writing. Both sides then sign an ekhin, an advance agreement, with a token of about 5 percent. The seller clears tax at the Malpot office, and you register the sale and pay the transfer tax on the same day.

Most purchases finish in three to five weeks.
